summary.text: Fire Gu is a Gu of *The Legends of Ren Zu* that Northern Dark Ice Soul finds starving deep in black heaven, a lump of fire that eats almost anything and grows as it is fed.

claims.text: With Spectral Soul Demon Venerable charging into the sun, the three venerables watch as the wild rank nine fire Gu within the sun is no longer concealed. Spectral Soul Demon Venerable reaches the center of the sun, grabs fire Gu with his remaining tens of arms despite the intense flames, and his left head opens its mouth and devours it. He cries out in agony and his left head burns like a flame pillar, and without the support of fire Gu and of a second rank nine Immortal Gu, held by a legendary beast that flees the sun in fear, the sun explodes with a sound that spreads throughout the entire world.

price_claims.text: Deep within the two heavens, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable is covered in fire and growling in pain, which is the price of swallowing rank nine fire Gu.

claims.text: Deep within black heaven, where a lump of fire is the only light, Northern Dark Ice Soul finds that the fire is a Gu, and it tells him its name is fire. Weak and starving, fire Gu offers to light his way back to the ground once he feeds it, saying that no Gu worm in the world is less picky and that it can eat almost anything. Fed branches, it shines more brightly and grows from the size of a fist to the size of a basin, then condenses into a small lump so he can carry it on his return journey and feed it along the way. When trees, beasts and insects fleeing the dream realms chase him toward its light, fire Gu calls them its food, he tosses it at them, and it burns the walking meat trees to ash and cooked meat.

As its fire spreads from the walking meat trees to the beasts, fire Gu grows tall and imposing, with ruthlessness and madness in its voice, and says one spark can set a whole forest burning. It calls Northern Dark Ice Soul its true friend, since the life forms of black heaven feared it but needed it against the dream realms and so imprisoned and starved it, while he alone helped it. When a dream realm swallows him, fire Gu pounces on the pack of dream realms, which shrink and melt in its light, and its sea of fire spreads over black heaven until the one holding him melts and he wakes. He asks why it woke him, and when it answers that dreams often run opposite to reality, he refuses to listen and cuts off its protest, so it falls silent and opens a path for him to run off in search of another dream realm.
Fire Gu is a legendary Immortal Gu recorded in The Legends of Ren Zu, and it is rank nine when Spectral Soul Demon Venerable devours it.

Healing in Longevity Heaven, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable thinks that devouring the wild rank nine fire Gu was an extremely stupid move. He reasons that the insane Spectral Soul Demon Venerable has no way to refine fire Gu, and that fire Gu will fight desperately inside his body, expending his soul path dao marks.

Once his injuries have healed, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable thinks that if Spectral Soul Demon Venerable keeps fighting fire Gu, the two would suffer heavy injuries and the venerables would fight over them again.

Bathed in fire and tortured for tens of days, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable has a body shrunk by thirty percent, only several hundred of his arms left and one of his three heads burned to ashes. Under the threat of survival, rank nine fire Gu erupts with its strongest attack, though its firepower has clearly fallen. Feng Jiu Ge, a rank eight Gu Immortal, says that if Spectral Soul Demon Venerable still had his senses he could definitely capture fire Gu, and that if he could isolate the natural essence of the world, fire Gu would not have such terrifying power. Three days after Feng Jiu Ge uses his immortal killer move Destiny Song, the red flames on Spectral Soul Demon Venerable turn to a grey-blue cold, he quiets and recuperates, and he does not refine the wild fire Gu while fire Gu stops attacking and resisting him. Inside his body an intricate relationship forms in which the two start helping each other.
Fang Yuan takes the coexistence of Spectral Soul Demon Venerable and the wild fire Gu to be an effect of destiny song, and finds Feng Jiu Ge’s killer move stronger than before.
Spectral Soul Demon Venerable has resonated with rank nine fire Gu, and his soul foundation has surged to a terrifying level after he slaughtered billions of living beings in the two heavens.

With only one of his three heads left and a large blue fire burning on his body that gives off a strong chill, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable is forced into a desperate situation, and rank nine fire Gu, feeling the danger to its host’s life, finally uses its strength. All three venerables retreat from it, and Fang Yuan’s killer move that deceives Spectral Soul Demon Venerable cannot deceive the Gu, because it is a Gu worm and not a soul beast. The blue fire spreads toward the heaven path dream realms, which shrink and burn, and most of the remaining dream realms are destroyed by fire Gu. Fang Yuan thinks that The Legends of Ren Zu stated that dream realms are restrained by fire Gu, and that it looks true.

As Central Continent Gu Immortals watch Star Constellation Immortal Venerable suppress Spectral Soul Demon Venerable inside Heavenly Court, a remark is made that unless the rank nine fire Gu in his body activates, he will not break out of his predicament.
